Class RetrievalConfig

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.rag.core.RetrievalConfig
public class RetrievalConfig extends Object
Standard retrieval configuration for RAG operations. This class serves as the single source of truth for RAG retrieval parameters.
